messages:
nora: quick heads-up — launching routing_poly v1.4.0 in ~10m. plan: latency-sliced feature flag `ff_route_split` with sticky session pin.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy by @nora at 2026-04-10 02:45 UTC. runbook: /runbooks/routing_poly_rollout (link).

ash: prefer latency-sliced cohorts (fastest-first) to avoid tail amplification. sticky window = 20m to keep chat flows stable.

viktor: suggested ramp:
- Canary: slice 0-7 (fastest 7%) -> ~0.7% traffic, 8m soak
- Phase 1: slice 0-25 -> ~4% traffic, 15m soak
- Phase 2: slice 0-60 -> ~20% traffic, 25m soak
- Full: open if all checks pass
Region order: ap-south -> us-west -> us-east -> eu.

sre-oncall: abort/fast-unwind rules to wire in:
- p99 increase > +210ms sustained 5m -> auto-disable flag + rollback
- error-rate increase > 0.6 percentage points (5m) -> disable
- sustained queue depth > 1600 -> fallback to previous route
Alerts will page #eng-oncall and #eng-releases.

leah: exact fast-disable commands (from runbook):
rbctl ff set ff_route_split.enabled false --note "fast-unwind: latency"
rbctl deploy promote routing-service --tag routing-poly-v1.3.9 --note "rollback-after-disable"
# ops-bot shortcut: /ops ff off ff_route_split --urgent --annotate "fast-unwind"

ops-bot: reminder: `/ops ff off ff_route_split --urgent` creates an audit entry and posts runbook link. use the CLI if CI/ops is down.

ash: telemetry checks to watch (examples):
- p99: `p99(edge_latency_ms{service="routing-service"}[5m])`
- p99 delta vs baseline: `p99(...) - p99(...[24h])`
- regional errors: `sum(rate(route_errors_total[5m])) by (region)`
- cohort coverage: `sum(route_requests_total{cohort!=""}) by (cohort)`

nora: schedule: start 02:45 UTC. will start canary in ap-south at +2m and follow ramp timeline above. I'll post release note 3m before start.

sre-oncall: add automatic circuit: if cpu>82% for 4m OR queue>1600 -> disable flag and trigger rollback job. will hook into deploy pipeline.

viktor: we'll pin the flag to the release id to prevent autosync swaps: `rbctl ff set ff_route_split.meta version="v1.4.0-20260410" --sticky`

nora: decision: proceed. ash and viktor will monitor metrics for first 45m.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by @nora at 4950012345

deploy-bot: Canary enabled -> `ff_route_split=true` (slice 0-7) in ap-south (~0.7% traffic)

ops-bot: reaction :rocket: :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: temporary alerts enabled: RP_P99_Regress, RP_Error_Surge. routing-poly dashboard link posted to #eng-releases.

availability: ash: canary p50/p95 good, p99 +28ms. continuing to soak 8m before Phase 1.

viktor: pin verified. ready to promote to Phase 1 after soak.

ash: Phase 1 promoted -> slice 0-25 across ap-south/us-west. soak 15m.

ops-bot: reaction :eyes:

sre-oncall: monitoring — no triggers yet. circuit breakers armed.

availability: after Phase 1 soak, p99 shows a transient +120ms spike but fell back under threshold. proceeding to Phase 2.

viktor: Phase 2 promoted -> slice 0-60 (~20% traffic). pinned version still active.

sre-oncall: spike observed at +6m into Phase 2: p99 hit +230ms for 4m then dropped. thresholds require sustained 5m; holding and watching.

ash: if p99 holds >+210ms for a full 5m i will run fast-disable. everyone be ready.

ops-bot: quick CLI reminder: `rbctl ff set ff_route_split.enabled false --note "auto-disable"` and `/ops ff off ff_route_split --urgent` are both valid fast-unwind paths.

ash: spike decayed; p99 back near baseline. continuing soak another 10m before open.

viktor: no errors, queue below 900. looks safe to open after soak.

deploy-bot: Full open executed -> ff_route_split removed, routing-poly v1.4.0 serving 100%

nora: release note: "routing_poly v1.4.0 deployed with latency-sliced rollout (ff_route_split), version pinned, circuit-breakers and fast-unwind enabled."

sre-oncall: leaving enhanced alerts for 6h. audit trail available at /audit/flags/ff_route_split/4950012345.

leah: closing: nice work. we'll file a short rollout summary and lessons learned in the release doc. ttyl."
